title: Картка експозиції
fields_and_relations: Добірки, readiness і точки з різними життєвими циклами.
required_interaction: Відкрити/закрити експозицію, масовий readiness check; URL після закриття зберігаються.

implementation.view_model: Exhibition sets/points in separate tabs; atomic open/close/archive
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v7; v1–6 migration preserves user work and revoked existing grants
permissions: Explicit museum.write grant + account ownership + archive scope; R05-M never grants access
Guest resolver requires current approved exact revision and explicit museum/view/cite use
implementation.atomicity: Commands mutate a clone, verify revisions/ownership/policy, validate snapshots and file hashes, then commit once. Review and final set revision are atomic; closure archives points atomically.
limitations: Local browser prototype, no shared server deployment or cross-device persistence. QR encodes its real local resolver URL.
Museum selection supports publication targets O55; other target types and per-item translated texts remain pending. Museum record URL is supported; registry synchronization is not.
Online kiosk only; offline cache, audio/video, device provisioning and daily analytics remain pending.
Rights withdrawal derives needs_review immediately on read; durable invalidation jobs await backend.
Four curator-text languages supported; navigation remains Ukrainian.
Request replies do not publish sources or change access. Correction acceptance/application through archival reconciliation remains pending; reasoned rejection is supported.
Approved public archive contact is not yet configured.
